verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions an official Windmill client SDK in any language. It documents a published OpenAPI spec, a Scalar API reference, the `wmill` CLI and an MCP server. These are adjacent building blocks or different features and earn no credit for an official-SDKs story. For a developer platform like Windmill the axis clearly applies, so absence of evidence is "none".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
